<a id="arena2_screen"></a>
### [`arena2_screen`](../../../../src/graphics/arena2_screen.asm#L6) `$E000-$E3E7`

*data*

Screen RAM of the arena that is not on screen, 40 bytes for each row. The bytes differ from part 2. $8e20 swaps rows 7-22, columns 4-35 with $4400. Nothing reads the other bytes of $e000-$e3ff.

- **Read by:** [`check_attack_hit`](../combat/hits.md#check_attack_hit), [`apply_hit_damage`](../combat/hits.md#apply_hit_damage), [`spawn_hit_sprite`](../combat/hits.md#spawn_hit_sprite)
- **Referred to by:** [`swap_centre_colours`](../screen/scene.md#swap_centre_colours)
